tools.description: Read the authenticated user's tracked ticket trees and tracking lifecycle. Provider placement ids and sportsbook deep links are never returned.
tools.name: get_tracked_slips
tools.title: Tracked slips

tools.description: Create or revise one of the authenticated user's ticket trees. This stores truth state only; it never places, prepares, or hands off a wager.

expected_revision.description: Required with ticket_id; stale writes fail with a conflict.

ticket.description: BSD two-level BetTicketContract. SGP children stay nested under one outer pick.

ticket_id.description: Server ticket id when revising an existing tracked slip.

tools.name: track_slip
tools.title: Track a slip

tools.description: Live sports board: upcoming and in-play games with main-market prices (moneyline, spread, total) and the best posted price per selection across connected books. Read-only decision support; never a guarantee and never a wager.

leagues.description: League labels to filter by, e.g. ['MLB','NFL']. Omit for all leagues.

limit.description: Games to return (default 20, max 50). Live plus soonest first.

tools.name: get_todays_board
tools.title: Today's board (live odds)

tools.description: Submit betslip text and get BetSlip Doctor's graded second opinion: rank, score, per-leg calls, ten-dimension checkup and sourced evidence. Entertainment/decision support only. Uses the user's plan allowance exactly like grading in the app.

mode.description: Research depth. 'fast' (default) answers quickly; 'deep' fans out to every research provider.

slipText.description: The betslip as pasted text: one leg per line with odds where known.

stake.description: Optional stake in dollars for payout context.

ticket.description: Optional BSD two-level BetTicketContract. Use this for screenshot/manual parses and SGP trees.

tools.name: grade_slip
tools.title: Grade a betslip

tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved diagnosis reports (newest first), or fetch one full report by id. Only ever the calling user's own reports.

report_id.description: Return this one report in full instead of the compact list.

tools.name: get_saved_reports
tools.title: Saved reports

tools.description: The authenticated user's imported betting-history ledger: W-L record, stake and net over lifetime/30d/7d windows, sync freshness, and their most recent bets. Numbers come only from the user's own imported slips; nothing is fabricated.

recent.description: How many recent bets to include (default 5).

tools.name: get_history_summary
tools.title: Betting history summary

tools.description: Compare posted prices across books for each leg of a slip (main markets). Reports every book's quote, the best price for the bettor, and how much the user's own line gives up. Only ever describes books with real posted data; read-only, never places a wager.

book.description: The book the user is on (e.g. 'draftkings'), if known.

odds.description: The american odds the user is on (e.g. -120), if known.

tools.name: price_shop_slip
tools.title: Price-shop a slip
